create_TalkTheWalkEmergent_dataset: create a TalkTheWalkEmergent dataset for emergent language experiments with configurable trajectory length T
create_TalkTheWalkLanguage_dataset: create a TalkTheWalkLanguage dataset from human annotator dialogues with utterance and action tracking
create_TalkTheWalkLandmarks_dataset: create a TalkTheWalkLandmarks dataset for landmark classification using resnet, fasttext, or textrecog features
create_Map_with_landmarks: create a Map object that loads neighborhood landmarks and transforms map coordinates for navigation
call_get_orientation_keys: call get_orientation_keys to get landmark-facing orientation keys at a given x,y grid location
